facts.value: Resolves Fighter and its animation skeleton from gobj. A nonzero supplied weight causes HSD_JObjAnimAll, followed by ftAnim_8006FE9C(fp,FtPart_TransN,w,1-w) unless w equals 1, when ftAnim_8006FF74 is used. These helpers affect eligible parts starting at TransN. Ordinary Fall, FallAerial, and FallSpecial callers pass their persistent x4 value after updating it through ftCo_Fall_Anim_Inner. No move-variable assignment or ownership transfer occurs in this helper.

facts.value: Both signed zeros skip animation application. Any nonzero input evaluates the skeleton; exactly 1 uses the eligible-part copy helper, while all other nonzero values use the weighted helper with (w,1-w). The source does not clamp weights or reject NaN/infinity; under ordinary floating comparison semantics NaN reaches the weighted branch. No motion selection or direct move-variable write occurs here.

facts.value: Reads x2228_b2 from the associated Fighter. If clear, passes &mv.co.fall.x4 and the FtMotionId animation motions ftCo_SM_Fall, ftCo_SM_FallF, ftCo_SM_FallB to ftCo_Fall_Anim_Inner, then passes the updated x4 value to ftCo_800CC988. If set, neither helper is called. The three SM identifiers are animation-motion IDs, not the MS action-state domain.

facts.rationale: Makes guards, strict boundaries, distinction from physical velocity clamping, and external interpolation invariants explicit.
facts.value: Computes r=self_vel.x/air_drift_max and saturates ordered r outside [-1,1], without changing self_vel.x. Magnitude strictly above x444 selects forward if r*facing_dir>0, backward otherwise, with target (abs(r)-x444)/(1-x444); otherwise it selects neutral and target zero. Updates caller state w by w+=x448*(target-w). Only nonzero updated w and a changed selected ID trigger ftAnim_8006EDD0 with cur_anim_frame and rate 1, skeleton evaluation, eligible-part application starting at TransN, and a stored fall.smid update. No finite/range checks guarantee bounded or convergent weights. A zero updated weight prevents even a neutral-motion replacement. NaN bypasses ordered ratio saturation; actual exceptional-float execution depends on target semantics.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact ordering while avoiding unsupported unchanged-state conclusions.
facts.value: Calls ftCo_SpecialAir_CheckInput, ftCo_80095328(gobj,NULL), ftCo_800D7100, ftCo_800C3B10, ftCo_80099A58, ftCo_AttackAir_CheckItemThrowInput, ftCo_800D705C, ftCo_800CEE70, ftPe_8011BA54, ftCo_800CB870, and ftPe_8011BAD8 in exactly that priority. Returns true immediately after the first truthy result, skipping later checks; returns false only if all return false. The function has no direct Fighter-field mutation, but all-false does not establish absence of callee side effects.
